definition: Projected radius from the M101 centre to which Mihos et al.'s (2013) deep imaging traces the disc's starlight: 25 arcmin, 48.8 kpc at 6.71 Mpc (50 kpc at their 6.9 Mpc).
quote: has revealed the stellar structure of M101's disk out to nearly 25 arcminutes (50 kpc)
presentation: Where the galaxy's stars are still measured: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary.
